audit.notes: The new chapter blocks comprehensively cover the scientific content of the old draft. Specifically: Block 1 covers inverse design foundations and physics-informed ML (Old Para 3, 4). Block 2 covers hybrid algorithms, adjoint methods, and generative models/foundation models (Old Para 3, 4). Block 3 covers transmissive/reflective architectures and hybrid meta-refractive lenses with specific efficiency metrics (Old Para 1, 2). Block 4 covers deep learning for polarization control and quad-channel multiplexing (Old Para 5). Block 5 covers non-uniqueness and crosstalk bottlenecks (Old Para 6). Block 6 covers dynamic systems including BICs/humidity modulation and microfluidics (Old Para 7). Block 7 covers AR waveguide readiness and limitations (Old Para 2, 7). No scientifically useful mechanisms, comparisons, or quantified results from the old draft are missing in the new blocks.
